title: OPH-FEP-Synergetics: executable correspondences, obstructions and complementarities across Observer Patch Holography, the Free Energy Principle, and Fuller's Synergetics

creators.name: Mueller, Bernhard
creators.affiliation: Pragma Research and Active Inference Institute

description: Fifty-three executable probes compare finite models from Observer Patch Holography, the Free Energy Principle, and Fuller's Synergetics. They cover the carrier graph, integer repair and its gated variant, cellular sheaves, linear-Gaussian inference and effective resistance, and the distinction between close-packed coordination shells and Euclidean distance. The registry records each result's domain and reports counterexamples alongside the identities.
